sourceNote: All values are deterministic demo observations shaped like Ethereum mainnet aggregates. No RPC, indexer, wallet, or transaction is called by this page.

metrics.label: DEX sell pressure
metrics.rationale: Gross ETH sell volume is almost twice the previous-window baseline; this is the main short-horizon warning.

metrics.label: Realized volatility
metrics.rationale: Higher volatility widens the left tail and makes the same liquidity shock more damaging.

metrics.label: Price run-up
metrics.rationale: A fast run-up raises crash probability without implying that the unconditional mean return must be negative.

metrics.label: Leverage growth
metrics.rationale: Accumulated leverage is a slower moving vulnerability that can turn a market shock into forced selling.

metrics.label: Stablecoin liquidity gap
metrics.rationale: A negative depth gap means less exit capacity is available when sell pressure arrives.

metrics.label: Explosive-dynamics proxy
metrics.rationale: The proxy is above its illustrative critical region; it is a bubble-state input, not a crash timestamp.

models.title: Threshold early-warning
models.rationale: The threshold layer is intentionally legible: it shows exactly which observable conditions are active and avoids hiding the trigger inside a black box.

models.title: Crash probability
models.output: Illustrative probability: 31% for ≥12% drawdown in 10d (not fitted)
models.rationale: The score is a deterministic demo proxy. The displayed probability is an illustrative placeholder, not a fitted or out-of-sample estimate.
models.citation: Chen, Hong & Stein (2001); Beutel et al. (2019)

models.title: Explosive price state
models.rationale: This model detects explosive dynamics; it is evidence of fragility and does not claim that a crash must happen immediately.

models.title: Liquidity regime
models.rationale: A sell shock has a larger expected loss in a fragile regime, so the same flow is not interpreted in isolation.
models.citation: Acharya, Amihud & Bharath (2013); Jiang et al. (2022)

models.title: Left-tail quantile
models.rationale: The tail estimate focuses on the loss distribution rather than the average return, which is the decision variable for a defensive position.

composite.interpretation: Several independent layers agree that ETH is fragile: sell pressure and volatility are immediate, while leverage and explosive dynamics are slower structural warnings.

recommendation.action: Reduce ETH exposure by 20–30 percentage points; pause new leverage and keep a stablecoin liquidity buffer.
recommendation.rationale: The recommendation is sized to the overlap of model signals, not to a single forecast. It is a risk budget suggestion and does not execute trades.

evidence.label: Regression horizon
evidence.source: Model design derived from cited papers

evidence.label: Known limitation
evidence.value: Synthetic fixture; no live chain refresh or fitted standard errors
